method: two-way partitioned DEM-FEM coupling (4C PASI): DEM grains falling onto a clamped nonlinear neo-Hookean membrane
code: 4C (open-source successor of BACI), Docker image ghcr.io/4c-multiphysics/4c:main
notes: 4 earlier attempts with Aitken relaxation/tight tolerances aborted at impact with 'The partitioned PASI solver did not converge in ITEMAX steps!'; final run uses fixed relaxation 0.5, disp tol 1e-5 m, IGNORE_CONV_CHECK.
